author: turboderp
message:
Merge pull request #3 from async0x42/fix-setup-tools

Fix Issue #2, Error: setup script specifies an absolute path
problem: The first parent still has absolute extension-source paths; the second parent contains Async0x42’s fix from entry 000009.
reasoning: Merges that change into the main line. The first-parent diff is byte-identical to entry 000009’s diff, so the merge is evidence of integration rather than a second independent implementation. Both parents are retained in the identity record.
impact: The default development line acquires the relative-path packaging fix. Future sampling should deduplicate the repeated change rather than overweight the contributor commit and merge.
source_notes: Retrieved 2026-11-09: PR https://github.com/turboderp-org/exllamav3/pull/3, its conversation/review/inline-comment endpoints, and issue #2 with comments. PR body links issue #2. Two eligible conversation comments report that the fix worked and acknowledge the oversight; no reviews or inline comments were returned. Issue body remains excluded because updated_at is one second after the 2025-04-07T10:16:26Z cutoff. Filtered source ledger: data/sources/000010-threads.json.
confidence: High for integration and duplicate-diff identity. The successful-install report is a third-party report, not a build executed by exdev. Issue-body history remains unavailable.
